posts.title: 10-year TIPS auction gets real yield of 2.903%, highest in 24 years
posts.description: By David Enna, Tipswatch.com Today’s reopening auction of a 10-year TIPS — CUSIP 91282CRE3 — generated a real yield to maturity of 2.903%, the highest for this term at auction since July 2002. That 2002 auction — in the early … Continue reading →
